description: Sistema Idrico Integrato: Fognature - Rete Fognaria is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geonavsct.partout.it. Localization of the sewerage network with coverage over the entire territory of the Autonomous Region of Valle d'Aosta. Acquired and transmitted by BIM (Consorzio dei Comuni della Valle d'Aosta Bacino Imbrifero Montano (BIM), the governing body of the Integrated Water Service (EGA)), the data derives mainly from surveys carried out in 2014. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Integrated Water System: Sewerage - Sewerage Network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include mappa_privata. The listing shows 2022-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
